title: Nine Months Behind the Counter
subtitle: 助手与店员 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 助手与店员（社会服务与人际沟通·职业与岗位）
meta: 主题语境：助手与店员（社会服务与人际沟通·职业与岗位）　|　核心词汇：assistant　|　正文 314 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 assistant 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1974 my mother became ① an assistant to a man who never learned her name, and she said that was the job. The ② assistant, meaning the person and not the title, did nine things a day and was thanked for one; an assistant, she said, is somebody who is paid to know everything and say nothing. She said the knowing was the easy half.

Every ③ assistant in that shop lasted nine months, and she said the shop was designed for that. Their  assistant on Saturdays was a boy of sixteen who knew the prices by heart; an assistant, my father said, is the only person in a shop who is not allowed to be wrong out loud. He said the boy was never wrong.

My grandmother had been ④ an assistant in a school in 1951, which my mother said was a different word entirely. The ⑤ assistant, meaning the job and not the person, is nine parts memory and one part patience, my mother said; an assistant, she said, is the only worker who is judged by how little anybody notices. She said her mother had been noticed once in eleven years.

By 1979 the ⑥ assistant had become the manager and the manager had become a name on a door. The ⑦ assistant she trained in March left in June and sent a card; an assistant, my father said, is the only person you are sorry to lose twice. He said the card was worth more than the training.

The  assistant I remember is the boy of sixteen, who is now the only one of them I can name. An ⑧ assistant, my mother said in 1983, is the only person in a room who knows how everything works and is not allowed to say so; every assistant, she said, is an expert with the licence taken away. She said the licence comes back with the title.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 助理；助手（一个人）
B. n. 助理（指人本身，与头衔相对）
C. 固定搭配：an assistant in a school 学校里的助教、助理
D. 固定搭配：become an assistant 成为助理
E. n. 助手（指培养出来又离开的那一位）
G. n. 助手（抽象总称；泛指）
H. n. 助理（指这份工作、这个岗位）

items.q: an assistant to a man who never learned her name
The assistant, meaning the person and not the title
an assistant in a school in 1951
The assistant, meaning the job and not the person
the assistant had become the manager
The assistant she trained in March
An assistant, my mother said in 1983

answers.why: become an assistant 意为“成为助理”，1974 年母亲成了一个始终没记住她名字的人的助理，她说这就是那份工作。
assistant 指“人本身”，与头衔相对，那位助理一天做九件事，只有一件被道谢。
assistant 意为“店员、售货员”，那家店里每一个店员都只干九个月，她说那家店就是照这个设计的。
an assistant in a school 意为“学校里的助教、助理”，祖母 1951 年在学校当过助理，母亲说那完全是另一个词。
assistant 指“这份工作、这个岗位”，与人相对，是九分记性加一分耐心。
assistant 意为“助理（一个人）”，到 1979 年那位助理成了经理，经理成了一扇门上的名字。
assistant 指培养出来又离开的那一位，她三月带出来的那位助理六月就走了，只寄了一张卡片。
assistant 为抽象总称，母亲说助理是屋里唯一知道一切怎么运转、却不被允许说出来的人。
